    Feasibility test

    The integral D socket connects directly to the motor shaft. An axial M5 insert and M5×16 bolt support the worm through a 625ZZ bearing in the chassis. The output retains four Ø3.4 mm through-holes for optional M3 inserts or through-bolts.

    Loading geometry checks…

    Fine-mesh collision screening with OCC solid-intersection confirmation at sampled positions. The oversized tooth flanks intentionally overlap to create preload; elastic deformation, stiffness, torque, friction, wear and axial-bearing life are not simulated. Do not assume self-locking. Motor controllers remain outside the enclosure and are not modeled.
